title: (No AI) California is trying to shut down robot vs. human cage matches
author: Jay Peters
content:
![](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/10/Screenshot-2026-10-08-at-4.18.11-PM.png?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

The California State Athletic Commission sent a cease-and-desist letter to a startup that hosted a match between a human and a robot last month, [as reported by _The New York Times_](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/10/08/technology/human-robot-cage-fights-california-rek.html).

The fight, which took place on September 18th, pitted a human, Frankie LaPenna, against a humanoid robot owned by a tech startup, Rek, that was being piloted by a human using what the _NYT_ described as a "remote virtual-reality system." Rek says it is the "the humanoid robot fighting league" on [its website](https://rek.com/fights), and the robot appears to be one from [EngineAI](https://en.engineai.com.cn/) but with a _Terminator_\-like head swapped on top.

You can watch a replay of the fight [on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4rg2sB6ELtk):

title: (No AI) USA Today becomes the latest publisher to sue OpenAI
author: Emma Roth
content:
![Illustration of OpenAI logo.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/02/STK155_OPEN_AI_CVirginia__A.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

USA Today Co., along with the several local newspapers it owns, is suing OpenAI over claims that the company copied "hundreds of thousands" of articles to train its AI models, [as reported earlier by _Reuters_](https://www.reuters.com/legal/legalindustry/usa-today-sues-openai-copyright-infringement-over-ai-training-2026-10-08/). In [a filing on Thursday](https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/28731453-usa-today-v-openai/), the publisher asks for damages of more than $250 million, alleging OpenAI's unauthorized use of its content "has done real and continuing" harm to its outlets.

This is just the latest in a string of copyright lawsuits filed against OpenAI. In [addition to a copyright lawsuit filed by _The New York Times_](https://www.theverge.com/2023/12/27/24016212/new-york-times-openai-microsoft-lawsuit-copyright-infringement), OpenAI is also facing [legal action from _The Intercept_](https://www.theverge.com/2024/2/28/24085973/intercept-raw-story-alternet-openai-lawsuit-copyright), [CNET owner Ziff Davis](https://www.theverge.com/news/656044/ziff-davis-sues-openai-ign-cnet-pcmag), [CBC/Radio-Canada](https://www.theverge.com/2024/11/29/24308984/openai-sued-canadian-media-copyright-chatgpt), [Encyclopaedia …](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/895372/encyclopedia-britannica-openai-lawsuit)

[Read the full story at The Verge.](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1008198/usa-today-openai-copyright-lawsuit)
